[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Slarin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the assistant of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Drowl]], and aided him to introduce the [[Quell toxin]] to stop a [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|rebellion]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Even so, Slarin believed Drowl's plan would be leaving the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] writhing in pain for weeks, and instead introduced a different dosage that would kill the slaves quickly. Slarin tried to give the modified toxin to an Imperial individual instead of the toxin that Drowl had given to them, but the individual insisted on Drowl's version.
